name: com.mandarelabs/mandare
title: Mandare
description: Verify an agent fleet's tamper-evident ledger, check budgets, kill a runaway agent. Local-first.

environmentVariables.name: MANDARE_LEDGER_DB
environmentVariables.description: Path to the Mandare ledger database this MCP server verifies and kills against

environmentVariables.name: MANDARE_MCP_HOME
environmentVariables.description: Directory where issued artifacts (mandates, credentials, token grant files) are written

environmentVariables.name: MANDARE_WITNESS_URL
environmentVariables.description: Witness server URL — enables truncation/rewrite checks and certificate export

environmentVariables.name: MANDARE_WITNESS_PUBLIC_KEY
environmentVariables.description: The witness's Ed25519 public key (64 hex chars), obtained out-of-band

environmentVariables.name: MANDARE_GATEWAY_URL
environmentVariables.description: Running gateway base URL — enables the gateway health tool

environmentVariables.name: MANDARE_MCP_ALLOW_REINSTATE
environmentVariables.description: Set to 1 to expose the reinstate tool (off by default; kills only close doors)
